content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new here but have been working with [company_name] [product_name] for about three years. I'm planning to upgrade my laptop to Windows 7 64-bit. Has anyone encountered issues or can share experiences running [product_name] on this operating system? Thanks, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], I hope this discussion helps you. [product_name] is compatible with Windows 7. Best regards, [user_name]
Thanks, I missed that previous discussion.

I recently installed [product_name] version [version_no] on Windows 64-bit. The USB drivers installed without any issues, and the software works at about 95%. One minor issue I've noticed is that the folder icons for UP and NEW are missing when loading or saving files, but clicking on the area where the icons should be still triggers the functions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users moving to Windows 7 64-bit systems want to know if [product_name], specifically version [version_no], works properly on the new OS. The software installs and runs well, though a minor issue with missing folder icons during file operations is noted; the relevant functions are still accessible in spite of the UI flaw.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to install and operate fully on Windows 7 64-bit, including all interface features and USB drivers.
